name: fal.ai Maya TTS
description: Maya1 is a state-of-the-art speech model by Maya Research for expressive voice generation, built to capture real human emotion and precise voice design.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/maya", { input: { text: "Hello world", voice: "default" } });

name: fal.ai MiniMax Speech 2.6 HD
description: Generate speech from text prompts using the MiniMax Speech-2.6 HD model with advanced AI for high-quality text-to-speech synthesis.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/minimax/speech-2.6-hd", { input: { text: "Hello world" } });

name: fal.ai MiniMax Speech 2.6 Turbo
description: Fast text-to-speech generation using the MiniMax Speech-2.6 Turbo model optimized for speed.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/minimax/speech-2.6-turbo", { input: { text: "Hello world" } });

name: fal.ai PlayAI TTS Dialog
description: Generate natural-sounding multi-speaker dialogues and audio. Perfect for expressive outputs, storytelling, games, animation, and interactive media.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/playai/tts/dialog", { input: { text: "Speaker 1: Hello!\nSpeaker 2: Hi there!" } });

name: fal.ai Whisper
description: Whisper is OpenAI's model for speech transcription and translation, supporting multiple languages.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/whisper", { input: { audio_url: "https://example.com/audio.mp3" } });

name: fal.ai Wizper
description: Wizper is Whisper v3 Large optimized by fal's inference wizards. Same WER (Word Error Rate), double the performance!

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/wizper", { input: { audio_url: "https://example.com/audio.mp3" } });

name: fal.ai MiniMax Music 2.0
description: Generate music from text prompts using the MiniMax Music 2.0 model, which leverages advanced AI techniques to create high-quality, diverse musical compositions.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/minimax-music/v2", { input: { prompt: "upbeat electronic dance music" } });

name: fal.ai Beatoven Music Generation
description: Generate royalty-free instrumental music from electronic, hip hop, and indie rock to cinematic and classical genres. Perfect for games, films, social content.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/beatoven/music-generation", { input: { prompt: "cinematic orchestral soundtrack" } });

name: fal.ai Beatoven Sound Effects
description: Create professional-grade sound effects from animal and vehicle to nature, sci-fi, and otherworldly sounds. Perfect for films, games, and digital content.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/beatoven/sound-effect-generation", { input: { prompt: "thunderstorm with heavy rain" } });

name: fal.ai Mirelo SFX Video-to-Audio
description: Generate synced sounds for any video and return the new sound track (like MMAudio). Automatically creates appropriate sound effects for video content.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/mirelo-ai/sfx-v1/video-to-audio", { input: { video_url: "https://example.com/video.mp4" } });

name: fal.ai Mirelo SFX Video-to-Video
description: Generate synced sounds for any video and return it with its new sound track (like MMAudio). Outputs video with automatically generated audio.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/mirelo-ai/sfx-v1/video-to-video", { input: { video_url: "https://example.com/video.mp4" } });

name: fal.ai Dia TTS Voice Clone
description: Clone dialog voices from a sample audio and generate dialog from text prompts using the Dia TTS model for high-quality text-to-speech with voice cloning.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/dia-tts/voice-clone", { input: { text: "Hello world", voice_sample_url: "https://example.com/voice.mp3" } });

name: fal.ai Sync Lipsync v2
description: Generate realistic lip sync animations from audio using advanced algorithms for high-quality synchronization with Sync Lipsync 2.0 model.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/sync-lipsync/v2", { input: { video_url: "https://example.com/video.mp4", audio_url: "https://example.com/audio.mp3" } });

name: fal.ai PixVerse Lipsync
description: Generate realistic lip sync animations from audio using PixVerse's advanced lip sync model for high-quality audio-video synchronization.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/pixverse/lipsync", { input: { video_url: "https://example.com/video.mp4", audio_url: "https://example.com/audio.mp3" } });

name: fal.ai ByteDance OmniHuman v1.5
description: Omnihuman v1.5 is ByteDance's improved version that generates video using an image of a human figure paired with an audio file. Produces vivid, high-quality animated videos.

examples.typescript:
import { fal } from "@fal-ai/client";
const result = await fal.subscribe("fal-ai/bytedance/omnihuman/v1.5", { input: { image_url: "https://example.com/person.jpg", audio_url: "https://example.com/speech.mp3" } });
